Scope: Native captured-prefix continuation against a local cookie-required origin; no live driver/browser capture.
SourceFindings: HttpStream.hpp HttpDecoder readHead intentionally filters Authorization, Cookie, Referer, User-Agent and other replay headers.
HttpRequest retains method, target, host and range but no replay headers.
CaptureObservationsJson.hpp and DesktopBroker.hpp pending offers have no protected header envelope.
CaptureAdmission.cpp reserveOriginalResponse calls add without Headers, so the catalog cannot replay authenticated range requests.
Passive parser core tests explicitly require credentials not to be retained.
RequiredFix: Retain bounded replay headers only when response admission is explicitly enabled; preserve passive-monitor behavior.
Keep credentials out of ordinary observation JSON, logs and error text.
Bind encrypted request metadata to the exact HTTP host and target across the authenticated helper pipe.
Validate and store replay headers using existing protected catalog headers before acknowledging ownership.
Prove successful cookie/authorization-required resume, origin isolation, malformed-envelope rejection, bounds, fallback and capture-mode transitions.
